intro.title: Everyone's Thoughts
intro.description:
What do others think when faced with the same question?

Connected anonymously, this is a space to write your honest thoughts and read each other's.
intro.disclaimer: Note: Profanity or inappropriate content may be blocked.

step1.title: Date
step1.description: Change the date to see the question from another day.

step2.title: Your answer
step2.description: Your answer is always pinned to the top and shared with others. You can edit or delete it anytime.

step3.title: Random nickname
step3.description: A fresh nickname is given every time you answer, so you can share freely without worrying about anyone's gaze.

step4.title: Anonymous feed
step4.description: Meet the diverse thoughts of others who answered the same question.
